arxiv_ref.title: Quadratic Speedup for Computing Contraction Fixed Points
arxiv_ref.core_result_1line: Quadratic speedup O(log^{ceil(k/2)}(1/eps)) vs prior O(log^k(1/eps)) for finding eps-fixed-points of contraction maps on [0,1]^k under l_inf and l_1 norms.
